feeds.title: Une Femme D'un Certain Âge » Style
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Susan Blakey and I'm 64 and marrited. I am a former administrative executive who loves and writes about style, Paris, coffee, history, travel and more. This section of the blog covers style ideas and fashion for women over 50. How to evolve your personal style. How to build a cohesive wardrobe for any lifestyle.

feeds.title: Is This Mutton?
feeds.description: A blog about fashion and beauty for sassy women over the age of 50, covering a light-hearted cornucopia of outfits, jewelry lifestyle, and beauty products. Authored by Gail Hanlon.

feeds.title: Mummabstylish
feeds.description: A blog about fashion and lifestyle aimed at ladies over 50, featuring fun ideas and fabulous fashion. Authored by Jacqui Berry.

feeds.title: Chic50Style Blog
feeds.description: Chic50style Womens fashion and lifestyle website for midlife trendy ageless chic. Discover how dressing over 50 style is discovering yourself again.The over 50 influencer & over 50 blogger Tina Dutton encourages mature women to stand out from the high street.

feeds.title: Chic at any age
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Josephine. My blog Chic at any age is a fashion and style inspiration blog for women over 50. This blog delivers information on how to continue to look chic at any age, advice on how to adapt fashion trends to suit your age, lifestyle, and personality.

feeds.title: That's Not My Age Blog
feeds.description: Advice on how to feel chic, comfortable, and confident in your clothes, interviews with women of style and substance, all the latest fashion news and expert beauty advice, hair, and skin care tips for women over-50 who want to look good, not young. Authored by Alyson Walsh.

feeds.title: Vanity & Me
feeds.description: Laurie Bronze writes about fashion, beauty, and lifestyle for women over fifty who aren't ready to say goodbye to their high heels just yet!

feeds.title: Frugal Fashion Shopper
feeds.description: Penny Kocher writes about finding wonderful clothes for the older woman in charity shops and issues around women and aging. She is 75 years old and has built up a great wardrobe on very little money.
